items.title: Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervention in abrupt board reversal
items.summary: Nov 23 (Reuters) - Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday under pressure from US President Donald Trump, a stunning reversal following his resignation over revelations of extramarital affairs, drawing approval from Wall Street and opposition from US lawmakers. Huang's comeback caps a whirlwind week of events that roiled markets and tore through the AI ecosystem that has ‌relied on Nvidia for everything from supplying chips to bankrolling the industry's massive buildout.

items.title: Nvidia shares soar more than 30% after Huang reinstated as CEO
items.summary: Nvidia shares soared more than 30% Monday and had their third-best day on record after the company announced it reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and president, effective immediately.

items.title: Asia FX subdued as dollar holds near 20-mth high on AI rally
items.summary: Investing.com-- Most Asian currencies were little changed on Tuesday as the U.S. dollar held near a 20-month high, with the reinstatement of Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang reviving enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and easing concerns over a potential slowdown in the U.S. economy.
